desc: Prove key invariants: position maps are monotone and 1-Lipschitz, so pieces never cross and pairwise distances never increase.
Derive the exact support reachability characterization via consecutive source groups, target eligibility intervals, and boundary gap constraints.
Design the monotone greedy feasibility test for a fixed operation count and binary-search the minimum.
Implement the O(N log N) aggregate algorithm.
Verify the implementation passes all public sample tests.
